# Website Uptime Monitoring - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import monitoredurls, uptimechecks, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="Website Uptime Monitoring API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build a website uptime monitoring system with website registration, health check...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(monitoredurls.router, prefix="/api/monitoredurls", tags=["MonitoredUrl Management"])
app.include_router(monitoredurls.router, prefix="/api/monitors", tags=["Monitors Management"])
app.include_router(uptimechecks.router, prefix="/api/uptimechecks", tags=["UptimeCheck Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "Website Uptime Monitoring", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to Website Uptime Monitoring API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for Website Uptime Monitoring
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class MonitoredUrl(Base):
    __tablename__ = "monitored_urls"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    url = Column(String(500), nullable=False, index=True)
    check_interval_seconds = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    expected_status_code = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    timeout_seconds = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class UptimeCheck(Base):
    __tablename__ = "uptime_checks"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    url_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    status_code = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    response_time_ms = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    is_up = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    checked_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Incident(Base):
    __tablename__ = "incidents"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    url_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    started_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    resolved_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=True)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    root_cause = Column(String(255), nullable=False)

# Automated Integration Tests for Website Uptime Monitoring
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_monitoredurls():
    res = client.get("/api/monitoredurls/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_monitoredurl():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test MonitoredUrl", "name": "Automated Test MonitoredUrl", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/monitoredurls/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test MonitoredUrl" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test MonitoredUrl"

def test_trigger_probe():
    res = client.post("/api/monitors/1/check")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["is_up"] is True

files.README.md:
# Website Uptime Monitoring

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Website Uptime & Latency Monitoring System
- **Description**: Reliability and synthetic uptime prober tracking URL availability, response latency, and outage incidents.
- **Primary Entity**: `MonitoredUrl`
- **Entities**: `User`, `MonitoredUrl`, `UptimeCheck`, `Incident`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate Synthetic Probers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS Time-Series
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph DevOps Engineers
    DASH["Uptime Status Page (React 18)"]
    ALERTS["Slack / PagerDuty Webhooks"]
  end

  subgraph Ingress & SRE Services
    ALB["Load Balancer"]
    API["Website Uptime Monitoring Uptime Controller"]
    SCHEDULER["Cron Probe Scheduler"]
    PROBER["Asynchronous HTTP/TLS Prober Engine"]
  end

  subgraph Monitored Target Endpoints
    SITE1["https://api.payments.com"]
    SITE2["https://auth.enterprise.io"]
  end

  subgraph Telemetry Storage
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Monitors, Checks, Incidents)")]
  end

  DASH --> ALB --> API
  API --> SCHEDULER
  SCHEDULER --> PROBER
  PROBER --> SITE1
  PROBER --> SITE2
  PROBER --> PG
  PROBER --> ALERTS
  API --> PG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/website-uptime-monitoring`
